question: Who is the renowned kathak dancer, student of ‘Pandit Birju Maharaj’ and also served as an officer with Indian Audit and Accounts Services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shovana Narayan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shovana Narayan** is a renowned Kathak dancer known for her exceptional contributions to the dance form.
 
• She is a student of the legendary **Pandit Birju Maharaj**, one of the most celebrated Kathak maestros.
 
• In addition to her illustrious dance career, Shovana Narayan has also served as an officer with the **Indian Audit and Accounts Services**.
 
• Her dual career in both dance and civil services highlights her multifaceted talents and dedication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is another eminent Indian classical dancer, but she is primarily associated with Bharatanatyam and Odissi.
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh** was a prominent Manipuri dancer and choreographer.
 
• **Padma Subrahmanayam** is renowned for her work in Bharatanatyam and is a respected scholar and choreographer.
 
• While all these artists have made significant contributions to Indian classical dance, it is **Shovana Narayan** who fits the description of being a Kathak dancer, a student of Pandit Birju Maharaj, and an officer in the Indian Audit and Accounts Services.
